title: British Scotch Egg
description: A classic British dish made from a hard-boiled egg wrapped in a layer of sausage meat, breaded and deep-fried.
instructions: Heat about 2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Dredge the scotch eggs in the flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured scotch eggs in the beaten egg and then coat in the breadcrumbs.
Carefully place the coated scotch eggs in the hot oil and fry for about 5 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the scotch eggs on paper towels and serve hot.
Serve with a side of ketchup or your favorite dipping sauce.
